events.title: 리버풀's slow start to the season continues as 애스턴 빌라 beat them 3–1 at Anfield in the Premier League.
All UEFA Champions League fixtures are cancelled following yesterday's terrorist attacks in the United States of America.
카디프 시티 pay £1.7 million for 스토크 시티 striker Peter Thorne in one of Division Two's biggest transfer fees yet.
Manager Jan van Dijk is fired by Dutch club 로다 JC and replaced by Belgium 's Georges Leekens .
토트넘 홋스퍼 pay 사우샘프턴 £8.1 million for defender Dean Richards .
마이클 오언 signs a new four-year contract with 리버풀 , with a £70,000 weekly wage making him the most highly paid player in the club's history.
토트넘 홋스퍼 surrender a 3–0 home lead over 맨체스터 유나이티드 in the FA Premier League and end up losing the game 5–3.

레스터 시티 sack manager Peter Taylor after 15 months in charge. His team have finished September in bottom place (they were top of the league this time last year before a late season slump dragged them into the bottom half of the table), in the Premier League relegation zone along with 더비 카운티 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드. At the top end of the table, 아스널 lead over 맨체스터 유나이티드 on goal difference, while 리즈 유나이티드, 볼턴 원더러스 and 선덜랜드 complete the top five. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 lead Division One, with 번리 in second place. 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 , 노리치 시티, 크리스털 팰리스 and 맨체스터 시티 complete the top six.
